title: Abstract Algebra
description: Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.

puzzle.goal: Write two four-component numbers as a real part plus a three-vector part, a + u⃗ and b + w⃗, where the three imaginary units square to −1 and anticommute. Multiply them out using vector operations only.
puzzle.name: Quaternion product (Hamilton product in scalar–vector form)
puzzle.lhs: ( a + vec ( u ) ) * ( b + vec ( w ) )
puzzle.form: a * b - vec ( u ) · vec ( w ) + a * vec ( w ) + b * vec ( u ) + vec ( u ) × vec ( w )
puzzle.ask: Find the k-component (third vector component) of the product of q₁ = 2 + i + 2j + 3k and q₂ = 3 + 4i + j + 2k.

vars.a: real part of the first quaternion

puzzle.method: Expand the product term by term; for two pure vectors use ij = k, jk = i, ki = j, ji = −k and i² = −1, and recognise the dot and cross products.
